base_input: SEL = DENS3 + DYN7 + STAB5 + STATE7; no CAL
topology_selection: N5 ranks 2022 contemporaneous power correlation within same 150km candidate pool; all other topology fixed by geography
aggregate: N3 uses same 8 neighbors and capacity-normalized MW sum, repeated to same token slots and same attention parameters
capacity_control: N2_SELF uses only delayed target history through identical neighbor parameters and geometry; N2 alone does not isolate regularization
mismatch: N2 jointly draws all neighbor histories from a different day of 2022 with same calendar month and local quarter-hour. Training excludes +/-1 day, validation uses only 2022 donors. Year-distribution shift is a limitation of this negative control.
latency: All delays use 22 observations; N7 retrains at 0/30 minutes, in addition to fixed-weight delay interventions
intervention_interpretation: Fixed-weight sensitivity, possibly out-of-distribution; not standalone proof of incremental value
outcome_strata: Future realized ramp labels used only to group prediction errors; thresholds fitted on 2022

gate.primary: W0 N1 vs W0 N0, 2023 all-horizon MAE, equal seed within farm then equal farm
gate.capacity_control_report: N2_SELF comparison mandatory; if it does not improve, do not claim proven real-time neighbor value
gate.fixed_primary: N1; N4/N5/N7 sensitivity results cannot replace failed primary gate after the fact

reporting: Actual farm/seed results mandatory; report every improvement and loss, including below 0.1%. The 0.1% threshold is the user-specified next-stage gate only.
next: After complete review, explicitly freeze revised joint 2024 protocol. Preserve previous B1 freeze; no 2024 execution in this screen.
storage: Reuse cache, no prediction files or attention-array copies, retain at most two selected weights, delete latest on success
